name: Cash Coin 1
definition: Withdrawal or deposit of an amount of money defined in cash coins.

BoxReference.name: Box Reference
BoxReference.definition: Reference for the box holding these coins.

CoinDenomination.name: Coin Denomination
CoinDenomination.definition: Specifies the coin denomination, including the currency, such as a euro 50 cent coin.

NumberOfCoins.name: Number Of Coins
NumberOfCoins.definition: Specifies the number of coins of the same denomination.

Amount.name: Amount
Amount.definition: Specifies the total amount of money for this coin denomination, that is the coin denomination times the number of coins.
